outcome: Imaging features of hepatic perivascular epithelioid cell tumor (PEComa)
Clinical significance for diagnosis of PEComa
cohort: Eleven patients diagnosed with hepatic perivascular epithelioid cell tumor (PEComa) who were treated at the study hospital.
finding: Specific imaging features such as clear margins, peripheral hyperechoic patterns, lateral shadow, large perilesional blood vessels, and the 'fast in and slow out (FISO)' enhancement pattern, particularly on ultrasound, are indicative of expansive tumor growth and are helpful in diagnosing hepatic PEComa.
